name: big-number
summary: One headline number: the last row's value over a sparkline of the rows, which names where it starts, with an optional target.

roles.name: y
roles.doc: the measure; the last row is the headline

roles.name: x
roles.doc: the period of each row, for the sparkline; monthly YYYY-MM periods name its start as "12 months ago"

roles.name: target
roles.doc: the goal for the headline value
